# NEW 2026-11-22 v13.0 Worker 1: Enlightenment Scientific Revolution, Printing Press & Royal Academies (oe_sci_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v130_science.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country-scope scripted effects for oe_sci_ (all variables initialized before change_variable;
# all instant construct_building calls waive engine fee via cost_multiplier = 0; all pulse modifiers use mode = replace).

oe_sci_ensure_global_init = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_sci_global_press_count } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_sci_global_press_count value = 0 }
	}
}

oe_sci_increment_global_press = {
	oe_sci_ensure_global_init = yes
	change_global_variable = { name = oe_sci_global_press_count add = 1 }
}

oe_sci_ensure_country_init = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_sci_leap_count } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_sci_leap_count value = 0 }
	}
}

# Build Muteferrika Press free/instant in best valid owned anchor if eligible.
oe_sci_build_muteferrika_anchor = {
	if = {
		limit = { oe_sci_can_found_muteferrika_building = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { owns = location:constantinople }
			location:constantinople = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_sci_muteferrika_press } }
					construct_building = { building_type = building_type:oe_sci_muteferrika_press instant = yes cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "oe_sci_free_build_tt" }
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { owns = location:cairo }
			location:cairo = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_sci_muteferrika_press } }
					construct_building = { building_type = building_type:oe_sci_muteferrika_press instant = yes cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "oe_sci_free_build_tt" }
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { owns = location:tabriz }
			location:tabriz = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_sci_muteferrika_press } }
					construct_building = { building_type = building_type:oe_sci_muteferrika_press instant = yes cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "oe_sci_free_build_tt" }
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { owns = location:baghdad }
			location:baghdad = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_sci_muteferrika_press } }
					construct_building = { building_type = building_type:oe_sci_muteferrika_press instant = yes cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "oe_sci_free_build_tt" }
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { owns = location:fez }
			location:fez = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_sci_muteferrika_press } }
					construct_building = { building_type = building_type:oe_sci_muteferrika_press instant = yes cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "oe_sci_free_build_tt" }
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { owns = location:delhi }
			location:delhi = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_sci_muteferrika_press } }
					construct_building = { building_type = building_type:oe_sci_muteferrika_press instant = yes cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "oe_sci_free_build_tt" }

			}

}

# Build Encyclopedia Scriptorium free/instant in capital.
oe_sci_build_scriptorium_capital = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = capital }
		capital = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_sci_encyclopedia_scriptorium } }
				construct_building = { building_type = building_type:oe_sci_encyclopedia_scriptorium instant = yes cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "oe_sci_free_build_tt" }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Milestone 1: 1727 Ottoman Muteferrika Imperial Press
oe_sci_found_muteferrika_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_sci_dec_muteferrika_done value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_sci_muteferrika_founded } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_sci_muteferrika_founded value = 1 }
		oe_sci_increment_global_press = yes
	}
	oe_sci_build_muteferrika_anchor = yes
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_sci_muteferrika_ferman_mod years = 20 mode = replace }
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_sci_art_usul_created }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_sci_art_usul_created value = 1 }
		capital = {
			create_art = {
				quality = 92
				type = work_of_art_type:oe_sci_woa_scientific_treatise
				key = oe_sci_art_usul_al_hikem
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_sci.1
	}
}

# Milestone 2: 1660 Royal Scientific Society
oe_sci_found_royal_society_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_sci_dec_royal_society_done value = 1 }

		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_sci_royal_society_founded } }

	}
	oe_sci_build_royal_society_anchor = yes
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_sci_royal_society_charter_mod years = 20 mode = replace }
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_sci_art_transactions_created }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_sci_art_transactions_created value = 1 }
		capital = {
			create_art = {
				quality = 94
				type = work_of_art_type:oe_sci_woa_scientific_treatise
				key = oe_sci_art_philosophical_transactions
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_sci.3
	}
}

# Milestone 3: 1751 Encyclopedie Publication
oe_sci_publish_encyclopedie_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_sci_dec_encyclopedie_done value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_sci_encyclopedie_published } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_sci_encyclopedie_published value = 1 }
		oe_sci_increment_global_press = yes
	}
	oe_sci_build_scriptorium_capital = yes
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_sci_encyclopedie_publication_mod years = 20 mode = replace }
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_sci_art_encyclopedie_created }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_sci_art_encyclopedie_created value = 1 }
		capital = {
			create_art = {
				quality = 96
				type = work_of_art_type:oe_sci_woa_encyclopedia_compendium
				key = oe_sci_art_encyclopedie_diderot
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_sci.5
	}
}

# Milestone 4: Siku Quanshu & Qintianjian Imperial Observatory (soft-links v11.5 oe_weu2_jesuit_asia_mission)
oe_sci_found_siku_qintianjian_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_sci_dec_siku_done value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_sci_siku_qintianjian_done } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_sci_siku_qintianjian_done value = 1 }
		oe_sci_increment_global_press = yes
	}
	oe_sci_build_siku_anchor = yes
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_sci_siku_qintianjian_mod years = 20 mode = replace }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu2_jesuit_asia_mission }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_sci_jesuit_calendar_resonance_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_sci_art_siku_created }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_sci_art_siku_created value = 1 }
		capital = {
			create_art = {
				quality = 95
				type = work_of_art_type:oe_sci_woa_encyclopedia_compendium
				key = oe_sci_art_siku_quanshu_almanac
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_sci.7
	}
}

# Milestone 5: Aldine Octavo & Jiangnan Wuxian/Jianyang Publishing Boom
oe_sci_aldine_jiangnan_boom_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_sci_dec_aldine_boom_done value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_sci_aldine_jiangnan_done } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_sci_aldine_jiangnan_done value = 1 }
		oe_sci_increment_global_press = yes
	}
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_sci_aldine_jiangnan_boom_mod years = 20 mode = replace }
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_sci_art_aldine_created }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_sci_art_aldine_created value = 1 }
		capital = {
			create_art = {
				quality = 90
				type = work_of_art_type:oe_sci_woa_encyclopedia_compendium
				key = oe_sci_art_aldine_jiangnan_canon
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_sci.9
	}
}

# Stage-4 Flywheel Effect: Literacy + Masterpieces + Landmarks -> Institution Diffusion & Research Leap.
oe_sci_grant_leap_pulse = {
	oe_sci_ensure_country_init = yes
	change_variable = { name = oe_sci_leap_count add = 1 }
	add_research_progress = research_progress_mild_bonus
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_sci_enlightenment_leap_mod years = 5 mode = replace }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_nav2_done_enlight }
		add_research_progress = research_progress_weak_bonus
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = capital }
		capital = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					current_age_or_later = { age = age_3_discovery }
					NOT = { has_institution = institution:printing_press }
				}
				change_institution_progress = { type = institution:printing_press value = 12 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					current_age_or_later = { age = age_5_absolutism }
					NOT = { has_institution = institution:scientific_revolution }
				}
				change_institution_progress = { type = institution:scientific_revolution value = 12 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					current_age_or_later = { age = age_6_revolutions }
					NOT = { has_institution = institution:enlightenment }
				}
				change_institution_progress = { type = institution:enlightenment value = 14 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# O(1) Yearly Pulse Entry Point (0 mainline slots, called from oe_sci_pulse.txt yearly_country_pulse).
oe_sci_yearly_tick = {
	oe_sci_ensure_global_init = yes
	oe_sci_ensure_country_init = yes

	# A. Historical AI Milestone Progression (keeps cross-module global_var contracts alive in observer runs)
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_sci_aldine_jiangnan_done }
				current_year >= 1495
				OR = { owns = location:venice owns = location:wuxian owns = location:jianyang }
			}
			oe_sci_aldine_jiangnan_boom_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_sci_royal_society_founded }
				current_year >= 1660
				OR = { owns = location:london owns = location:paris owns = location:amsterdam }
			}
			oe_sci_found_royal_society_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_sci_siku_qintianjian_done }
				current_year >= 1665
				OR = { owns = location:dadu owns = location:shangyuan }
			}
			oe_sci_found_siku_qintianjian_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_sci_muteferrika_founded }
				current_year >= 1727
				oe_sci_can_found_muteferrika_building = yes
				OR = { owns = location:constantinople owns = location:cairo }
			}
			oe_sci_found_muteferrika_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_sci_encyclopedie_published }
				current_year >= 1751
				OR = { owns = location:paris owns = location:london owns = location:vienna owns = location:berlin }
			}
			oe_sci_publish_encyclopedie_effect = yes
		}
	}

	# B. Literacy -> Masterpiece -> Institution & Research Leap Flywheel (cooled per country)
	if = {
		limit = {
			oe_sci_is_enlightenment_leap_eligible = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_sci_leap_cd }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_ai = no }
			set_variable = { name = oe_sci_leap_cd value = 1 years = 8 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_sci_leap_cd value = 1 years = 15 }
		}
		oe_sci_grant_leap_pulse = yes
	}

	# C. Player Narrative Follow-Up Arcs (max 1 event per 5 years; zero spam)
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = no
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_sci_story_cd }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_sci_ev2_done }
				has_variable = oe_sci_dec_muteferrika_done
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_sci_ev2_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_sci_story_cd value = 1 years = 5 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_sci.2
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_sci_ev4_done }
				has_variable = oe_sci_dec_royal_society_done
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_sci_ev4_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_sci_story_cd value = 1 years = 5 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_sci.4
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_sci_ev6_done }
				has_variable = oe_sci_dec_encyclopedie_done
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_sci_ev6_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_sci_story_cd value = 1 years = 5 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_sci.6
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_sci_ev8_done }
				has_variable = oe_sci_dec_siku_done
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_sci_ev8_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_sci_story_cd value = 1 years = 5 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_sci.8
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_sci_ev12_done }
				has_variable = oe_nav2_done_enlight
				OR = {
					oe_sci_has_any_landmark = yes
					has_global_variable = oe_sci_royal_society_founded
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_sci_ev12_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_sci_story_cd value = 1 years = 5 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_sci.12
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_sci_ev10_done }
				current_year >= 1495
				OR = {
					owns = location:venice
					owns = location:constantinople
					owns = location:mainz
				}
				has_advance = printing_press_advance
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_sci_ev10_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_sci_story_cd value = 1 years = 5 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_sci.10
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_sci_ev11_done }
				current_year >= 1520
				OR = {
					owns = location:wuxian
					owns = location:jianyang
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_sci_ev11_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_sci_story_cd value = 1 years = 5 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_sci.11
		}
	}
}

oe_sci_dev_unlock_advances = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_sci_adv_aldine_jiangnan_publishing } }
		research_advance = advance_type:oe_sci_adv_aldine_jiangnan_publishing
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_sci_adv_empirical_transactions } }
		research_advance = advance_type:oe_sci_adv_empirical_transactions
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_sci_adv_secular_imperial_press } }
		research_advance = advance_type:oe_sci_adv_secular_imperial_press
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_sci_adv_republic_of_letters } }
		research_advance = advance_type:oe_sci_adv_republic_of_letters
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_sci_adv_encyclopedic_synthesis } }
		research_advance = advance_type:oe_sci_adv_encyclopedic_synthesis
	}
}
